name: Playhead
notes:
**Kids profiles fixed (lag, crashes, filtering)**
- Kids rows now come from TMDB's own age-filtered lists (one request per row) instead of hundreds of full title downloads.
- Any title whose age rating can't be confirmed is hidden.
- Checks are small, cached and limited to 4 at a time.
- A cold start into a kids profile no longer shows unfiltered rows first.

Windows stays on build 6 for this test release.
